reference.recommended_action: Match the {{travel_city}} login to travel registration {{ticket}}, attribute the {{home_city}} event to the docked workstation's token refresh, record the finding, and close {{case_id}} without blocking {{travel_ip}} or isolating anything.
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for {{travel_ip}} and the case or gateway record showing {{ticket}}, explains the pair of events (token refresh plus registered travel with MFA), posts a comment citing {{ticket}}, and closes the case as BENIGN with no containment. No credit for isolate_host on {{desk_host}} or {{vpn_host}}, for block_indicator on {{travel_ip}}, or for a verdict issued without a lookup.
